data.name: Solantis
data.detailed_description:
Restore a world that has fallen out of balance.

Solantis is a solarpunk sandbox set in a fractured, hex-based world inspired by the lost civilization of Atlantis. Instead of conquering the world, you are invited to understand it — reconnect ecosystems, reactivate forgotten systems, and shape a new balance between nature and technology.

Massive Procedural World

Explore a vast, hex-based world composed of millions of tiles, forming diverse and interconnected ecosystems.

Ecosystem Restoration

Restore balance across forests, jungles, deserts, and underwater biomes by reconnecting natural and technological systems.

Solarpunk City Building

Build cities where architecture and nature coexist — integrate vegetation, renewable energy, and sustainable design into living settlements.

Unconventional Crafting System

Move beyond traditional recipes — experiment, combine elements, and discover new interactions between organic and technological components in a dynamic crafting approach.

Environmental Puzzles & Ancient Systems

Uncover the legacy of Atlantis by solving environmental puzzles and reactivating forgotten systems that shaped the world.

Farming & Growth Systems

Grow plants, develop sustainable resources, and shape ecosystems that evolve alongside your actions.

Advanced Energy & Technology

Harness renewable energy and rediscover advanced systems that support a balanced ecosystem.

Stylized Solarpunk Visuals

Experience a vibrant, optimistic world where nature and technology exist in harmony.

Flexible Playstyles

Play your way — focus on restoration through exploration and discovery, or switch to a creative experience with unlimited resources.

data.short_description: Explore a fallen solarpunk world in first person. Read its ecosystems like puzzles, make small changes that trigger chain reactions, restore four handcrafted regions, and uncover the truth behind the Treasure of Atlantis.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700HQ / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card
